notes: Each case runs in its own account through the real memoryObserve path. Achievement cases: `setup` creates the goals, `message` is the statement under test; `completed` goals must be closed as achieved in BOTH goal stores, `open` goals must stay open in both. Entity cases: `expect` maps a fact-key pattern to a value the fact must contain; `forbid` lists key patterns that must NOT hold the value. Multi-fact cases: `expect` as above; `noRunOn` lists strings that must never appear in the same fact value.
